steps.name: Memento mori (1)
steps.objective: Meet [Rif] in front of the bench in “Riftrasir”, talk to him, and complete the quest.

lines.text: (A clear sky without a single cloud, and the warm sunlight floating above it illuminates Liftrasir Square.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wanted to sleep well... .
(As %s was sitting on the bench, tilting his head back and looking at the sky, a playful elf came into view.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: What are you doing? %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, warden. I was just in a daze.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You were resting. I didn't disturb you, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Like the director said, it's comfortable because I just rest.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Was the accommodation inconvenient?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. That's not it, I have several thoughts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if you know... . I experienced a lot of things while traveling. There are things that have been resolved well, but there are also things that remain unresolved.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You have a lot to worry about. Don't go overboard and try to solve something right away. There are some things that will be resolved when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. However, it is not easy, perhaps because I am in a hurry.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I quickly get rid of any unpleasant feelings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Where have you been, Director?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I took a light walk. I took a walk around the forest and village. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I like it because it looks so stupid lying down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I see you, the director, you sometimes say harsh things too casually. I respect you.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll take that as a compliment. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this, warden?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, wait a minute. I have something to talk about, so would you please come to my house instead of here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, warden.

steps.name: Memento mori (2)
steps.objective: Check the situation in the restricted area in “Crystal Moon Forest” and report the quest to [Peta] in “Orcarium.”

lines.text: (Leif, who had been chatting brightly until just now as if joking, now has a hardened expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director? Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The forest is sad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is the forest sad?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: My words may be strange to %s, but after spending a long time in Riftrasir, I feel the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you say that you feel something like the energy of the forest?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I need to check... . %s, do you have a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It's okay now.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Then follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Follow along and you will find out.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: As expected... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's the problem here? ah… . I couldn't see it last time, but the color of the petals has changed now. Why is it like that... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The leaves and petals of the Crystal Moon Forest have never changed color since I was born.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It was fine a long time ago when demons coveted this place... . Right now it's just a few flowers, but it will increase little by little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who did this to the forest?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Because I can only feel it now... .  Hmm, who... Phew, I don't know.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It would be better to restore the colors of the trees and flowers quickly than to find out who it is. The method is simple, but there is a problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's the problem?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: We need the energy of a tree that contains the power of the spirit. In other places than here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . There is one place I know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Leaf briefly about the Orcarium.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Orcarium? This is the place where Orca, who was a semi-god, was waiting, right? I thought it was a place passed down through word of mouth, but it's surprising that it actually exists.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I think I can get the right energy there. I guess I'll have to explore a few places though.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you receive that spirit energy?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There is a type of magic paper that prevents magic from escaping from magical objects.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it like magical power protection wrapping paper? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's from the Ministry of Magic. Is it okay to use it?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's okay. Because safety is guaranteed, it is often used in the Empire and Alfheim.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Now, %s. Take the lead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I don't have time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Then follow me. I don't know the direct route from here, so I'll go via Knossos.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Director… ?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a crisis situation, so why do you seem happy?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's good when flowers and trees come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, not that one.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I don't know? I think it's nice to just go outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it true?... So I don't know which one is real.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehehe. %s, shall we go first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go when you're ready.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah… to get to the Orcarium, you have to pass through the camp first.)

steps.name: Memento mori (3)
steps.objective:
1. Explore a quiet place in 「Orcarium」. 
 2. Defeat [El-Larsa] in 「Spirit Stump」 and obtain <Tree Ring Rubbing>. Then, return to “Riftrasir” and complete the quest from [Rif].

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Haam… . I'm sleepy, I'm hungry... . Why is there nothing to eat here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was still there. feta.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Are you still there? Adventurer, when have you been here before?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: But where are you from? All paths to get here are blocked.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Well, I guess you figured it out.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: According to imperial law, anyone other than those related to the Ministry of Magic is currently prohibited from passing through this place.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I would like you to wait until the rest of the Ministry of Magic arrives.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a moment. feta. What are you talking about? I've been here before.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: This is my first time seeing Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Oh... . what? I definitely am. I was caught by Noname... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute. Is Noname alive?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Noname asked how he lived and said he was going to catch a witch... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Why is my memory a mess?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: … It's not like I met a witch.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Ah! Is it because you're hungry?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Peta's memory is distorted. I don't know if what happened when Narsha and I left was true or not...)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, has a witch appeared in the Orcarium?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not really. Phew.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: This wizard looks fine now.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: What brings the elf here? This is a place where anyone can come... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Could you please help me navigate here for a moment?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I need permission... . Adventurer cannot re-enter now. No matter how His Majesty orders it… . Ugh. eww… , hungry.
(Leaf makes an amused expression as he looks at Peta, who is frowning and holding his hungry stomach.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Are you hungry?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: We have a bunch of special cookies made by Liftrasir, what do you think? Would you like to try one?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: … Liftrasir’s special cookies are starlight cookies?
(Leif nods and puts his hand into a small envelope.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do elves have a lot of envelopes like this?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe, it's not a lot, but I do have it on rare occasions. Come on, wizard. If you help me get there after a little research, I'll give you a bunch of Alfheim cookies.
(Peta thinks seriously. But that only lasts for a moment. Peta catches the cookie shaking in front of her and puts it in her mouth.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: It will only take a moment, right?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Of course. Now, here. You can eat it all.
(Peta is impressed as Leaf presents a large box of starlight cookies.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Do you think you could easily give in to eating and go to the main office? Phew. By the way, when should I bring starlight cookies to Michaela?)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, if there is a unique place among the places you have been to in Orcarium, it will guide you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that person okay?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I think I woke up after meeting Adventurer. Just like we did... . There doesn't seem to be any major problem. If you're a magician, you'll take care of it. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Would it be okay if I just left it as Director Rift said? Still, it's a bit strange. How did what happened in Riftrasir affect this far...)
(An unknown shadow appears behind %s, who was thinking about various things. A gentle touch accompanied by someone's familiar strength....)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No. Then this is….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who, who is it?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What are you saying?)
(The black shadow grows larger as if encroaching on %s’s field of vision.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, let’s go.
(The moment Adventurer turns its back on Leaf's voice, the black shadows that fill the surroundings disperse like bubbles.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: … What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You look a little tired. sorry. Because of me… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's not like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I guess I heard wrong...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . Director, resolve this quickly and leave here.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Okay. If you have a hard time, please let me know at any time.
(%s's steps stop in a secluded place in the Orcarium where Noname met.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Is this where you met the boy? %s has also been through a lot.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's a bit surprising that the spirit that showed the way to travelers ended up like that. And you came to our town?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, following Your Majesty's prediction, I met a witch.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I didn’t join %s’s journey from the beginning, so I don’t know everything, but… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: If you need anything in the future, please let me know. I will help you as much as I can. I'm telling you this as the village representative, so it may come in handy someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Director. By the way, what do you think here?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Just a moment. Hmm… .
(Leif quietly closes his eyes and takes a deep breath.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Although this space feels special, there aren't many plants to energize it as they should.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It seems like the spirit's energy is concentrated over there, so let's go over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, if it’s over there… It's towards the spirit's stump... . hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Follow me, Warden.
(In front of the Spirit's stump, the entrance that was thought to have collapsed remains in %s's memories.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Have Geass and Harmonia made it normal again? It seems like I can go in.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Can I go inside there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can go in, but… . There are spirits that do not allow outsiders, so it can be dangerous.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe, don't look at elves easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said it's okay, so I'll trust you and go. Please follow me.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Yes, don't worry too much.
(The deepest part of the spirit stump where El-Larsa met. Traces of what was once a spirit tree greet the two.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s Thanks to you, I arrived here safely. You can also meet trees full of such good energy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad it came without any problems.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: But here… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's sadness itself.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I feel like I'm still full of pain and sadness. That's true everywhere, but especially here... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Throw away this feeling! I have to achieve my goal and go back!
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Leaf takes the paper out of his arms and places it on the base of the tree. Then, a mysterious light blooms around the paper.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll pray for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There is nothing in particular. Just watch.
(Leaf kneels, closes his eyes and prays. Then, the light around the paper gradually disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You prayed in unintelligible language. Is this done now?)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: That's it. When I lift it like this, the good energy is left on this paper.
(When Leaf unfolds the paper, the tree ring pattern at the base is clearly visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The tree rings are engraved as is. amazing.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hmm… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, there's no one else here but the two of us, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is no one. Did you feel something?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: If it were Liftrasir, you would have figured it out right away. Hmm. If you don't even know %s, there's nothing you can do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did the director feel that shadow too? I didn’t think so…)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Now, shall we go back? I organize complicated thoughts in Liftrasir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, warden.

steps.name: Memento mori (4)
steps.objective:
1. Talk to Jeril in “Song of the Lost Star” and defeat [Merlin] to obtain <Ominous Source of Fascination>. 
If you press the [Quest Complete Button] in the reward room, the next quest will automatically continue.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Thanks to you, it worked out well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? I came back to Riftrasir and didn't do anything?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: When we returned to Riftrasir, the clean energy from the Orcarium had already flowed into Crystalmoon Forest.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Now, look.
(Leaf holds up the paper that was a rubbing of the tree rings. The tree rings engraved on the paper have disappeared without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's true. Have plants in restricted areas returned?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I don't think there's any need to go and check now.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Whoa… . It seems like it’s been a while since I’ve been outside of Liftrasir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who did that anyway?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: If you touched the crystal moon forest without me feeling it, you wouldn't be an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, I don't know. I'd like to rest for now. %s can also eat and rest at the accommodation. Did you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much, because you will have a good rest thanks to Director Leaf's consideration.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe, then I guess I'll spend my retirement here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm still pale!

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Yes, I wish I was young. Then I will go in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I got a real kick out of it. Phew. Let’s go get some rest now… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Why are you here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can't rest like this.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It's been a while. Can’t you be more welcoming? Have you forgotten that we are not normal?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are we doing... .
(Jeril approaches %s's side with a smile on his face. He then reveals his purpose in a barely audible whisper.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: [Song of the Lost Star] Come inside because I have something to talk about. Be quiet alone. Otherwise I don't know what to do with you.
(The moment the boyishly innocent smile deepens and becomes cruel, Jeril next to him scatters like a shadow and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth are you trying to say... .
(As we enter the song of the lost star, a familiar person other than Jeril is looking at us with an unwelcome expression.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno will tell you more details.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Why did I... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That's right, you have Iris... .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: It's noisy... .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Then listen carefully.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you contaminate the plants? .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I've never done anything like that, and I don't want to do it. There's no time... . I don't know if this story will give you the answer you're looking for.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: The black moon wants light.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Black moon… .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: You must have vaguely felt it. An ancient god who has not shown himself, but who has been interfering with the path of you and Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait… .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Waking up in eternal space and looking at Iris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: That being doesn't want its name on sinners like us.
(As Kazno and Jeril quietly look at the sky, darkness that was not visible until just a moment ago begins to creep in.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: The power of the black moon is trying to silence us. I'll tell you more details when I meet you at the place you're going soon.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Because I can't do it here now.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno, good job.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Ah, %s. We have some work to do for you. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that... .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: As this darkness becomes darker, the song of the lost star can no longer exist. Then all of Riftrasir... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Find and destroy objects in places where people associated with witches have been. That will be able to send back this darkness.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It must have been here and the cathedral. Anyway, it's fun. A combination of a demon and a witch... .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: %s, I don't want your help, but I can't help it. Please survive.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: For Iris… .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hehe. That’s the charm of Kazno. %s, bye until we meet again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. The story isn't over yet!!
(Kazno and Jeril arbitrarily say goodbye and disappear in place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The witch's work alone is overwhelming, so why is there a god who interferes with Iris... .
(The darkness, as if hearing a voice full of resentment, becomes deeper and deeper.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, there is no time to stay like this. Let’s quickly go find those items.
(At the end of the Lost Star's Song, a small purple crystal shines.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems to contain strong magical power. Did Merlin have it?
“Even if it’s God’s protection, your current strength is probably achieved at the price of someone else’s death… .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do Merlin's words come to mind? Phew… , Don’t worry, destroy this… .
(The moment you try to approach the crystal, a black shadow approaches as if trying to get in the way. However, %s's weapon destroys the crystal first.)
(When the crystal is destroyed, the dark shadow that had been hovering over the song of the disappeared star scatters like dust and disappears as if it had never happened before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know who the master of the shadow is, but things won't go as planned... .
“In the face of death, I would rather beg for my life like other hypocrites. “That’s a better way.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I keep thinking about what Merlin said... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … why… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Never mind. I don't have time to stay here like this. Let's go to the cathedral quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Quickly… I have to go to the cathedral.

steps.name: Memento mori (5)
steps.objective:
In “Cathedral of Dusk,” defeat [Mordred] to obtain <Arthur Doll> and defeat [Morgana] to obtain <Pendant of Collapse>. 
And press [Quest Complete Button] in the reward room to end the quest.

lines.text: (The cathedral at dusk, which I ran to with worry, is filled with silence as no one is there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is no such thing as a shadow. Now, if there are any items related to Morgana, we need to find them quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Surely we don’t have to go all the way to the upper chapel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't think it would be easy. Let's go first.
(A pendant that appears to belong to Morgana can be seen in the chapel in the upper corner of the cathedral, in the corner of the place where Morgana was fought.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I definitely destroyed the pendant that Morgana had. Why is there another one here... . As if I had been waiting... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I don't know. Quickly take the doll and destroy the pendant... .
(The moment you are about to destroy the unfamiliar figure doll and pendant, a dark shadow flows in from somewhere.)
“What you believed in can be destroyed all at once.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Now it's Morgana's voice... . Don't disturb me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Destroy this... .
“Because right and wrong don’t matter anymore.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop it, stop it!
(The moment Adventurer's attack touches the shadow trying to stop the destruction, a huge shock wave occurs and shakes the quiet cathedral.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .
(As the dust that filled the chapel settles, bright light comes in through the window. When %s looks up, there is no longer any trace of the doll and pendant in his field of vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are we done? Since there's nothing, it's okay now, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Now let's go back.
(In front of %s, who is about to turn back, a large shadow slowly rises from the floor and appears in the shape of a human being.)
(While the voice of an unknown being flows from the shadows, the voice of a person I have heard before is mixed in.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: “Were the monsters that died in this [▒▒] really the [▒] that deserved to be hunted by you?”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This voice... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you!!
“The master of the black moon, ▒▒, and those who wait for the night.”
“You are not a god. Remember that you will die. “If you don’t forget that, nothing will happen.”
(With those words, the voice filled with all the distorted emotions in the world can no longer be heard. And the shadow that filled the chapel also recedes and is no longer visible.)
